repairs.configuration: Environment-first validated loading; private account JSON profile, explicit file override and bounded legacy literal assignments; no shell eval
repairs.persistence: Explicit configure saves a local owner-only profile outside Git; hidden token prompt only if existing settings are incomplete
repairs.scope: Same-account fresh terminals and isolated executor checkouts; children inherit settings; independent return/preparation checks load profile too
repairs.conflict: Reject conflicting partial environment; never combine saved token with another inherited origin
repairs.privacy: Controlled errors, no token output, no secret in public artifacts; POSIX owner/mode validation; existing different profile not overwritten
repairs.gates_only: Migration wrapper exits after successful readiness when explicitly requested; no formal_progress supervisor launched

validation.skipped_scope: POSIX private file mode check and pre-existing Linux-only missing-config installer test on Windows
validation.actual_shell_handoff: Git Bash plus fixture readiness/supervisor: gates-only stops, normal launch exit status preserved, readiness failure stops

boundary: No model equations, compiler policy, checkpoint scientific fields, recovery thresholds or cohort/sample budget changes; actual native stage timing still pending
